scythe_long.note: the shadow design's whole scythe laid straight (blade = scythe_whole turned +29 deg, shaft redrawn straight in the design's shaft colours): pommel left, blade right, joint = grip on the shaft (core rows = joint row and the row below). Use on 'scythe': ['sprite', 'scythe_long'] then rot/flip/deg/at - quarter turns stay clean (made for sh_ult_exit by poses/sh_ue/make_long.py).

hips.note: Leg pairs (legs_*): both legs in one sprite, joint = the hips' middle, which goes on the design's hips' middle (canvas 63, 86 = the torso joint). Use the pseudo-part 'hips': put 'hips' in the frame's 'order' where 'far_leg' was and leave out 'far_leg' and 'near_leg' (or 'hide' them), parts {'hips': [['sprite', 'legs_crouch', [63, 86]], ...more ops]}, and 'move': [0, drop] (the sprite's 'drop') so the hips come down with the body and the soles stand on the soles' row (legs_crouch/lunge/kneel; tuck and hang are airborne, 'low' = rows from the joint to the sprite's lowest pixel). The sash and robe (torso) stay drawn over the hips. Drawn by work/ka/legs_shadow.py.
